title: Welcome to ScanFinder — the 2-minute tour
description: The orientation video for a brand-new user: what ScanFinder does, that it runs entirely on your own PC, and where every action lives. Tours the left navigation rail, the Local-only shield, the dashboard cards, and the account menu (practice run + User Guide). No windows are opened — the rail items are pointed at, not clicked.

steps.narration: Welcome to ScanFinder. In the next couple of minutes you'll see what it does and where everything lives. In short: it reads your scanned documents, works out what each one is and who sent it, files it away tidily, and lets you find any of them later in seconds.
steps.caption: Welcome to ScanFinder

steps.narration: Everything you do sits on this bar down the left. Home is the dashboard you're looking at now — your at-a-glance view of what's going on.
steps.caption: The navigation bar, on the left

steps.narration: Import brings a folder of scans in. Review is where you check anything ScanFinder wasn't completely sure about — the small number that need a human eye.
steps.caption: Import brings scans in · Review is your check

steps.narration: Search finds any filed document. Teach shows ScanFinder where the details sit on a new supplier's documents, so it reads them correctly from then on.
steps.caption: Search finds anything · Teach adds a supplier

steps.narration: Export sends your records to a spreadsheet, and Settings and Help are here whenever you need them.
steps.caption: Export · Settings · Help

steps.narration: This shield down here is worth pausing on. ScanFinder runs entirely on your own computer. Your documents are never uploaded anywhere — everything stays local and private, and it works with no internet at all.
steps.caption: Local only — nothing leaves your PC

steps.narration: Back to the dashboard. This card tells you at a glance how many documents are waiting for a quick check in Review, so you always know if anything needs you.
steps.caption: Needs attention — what's waiting for you

steps.narration: And this one tracks how ScanFinder is getting smarter. As you teach a supplier and confirm a few of its documents, it begins filing that supplier on its own — so over time it does more and more of the work, and asks you less and less.
steps.caption: Getting smarter — it files more on its own

steps.narration: Up in the top corner is your account menu.
steps.caption: 1. Open the account menu

steps.narration: If you're brand new, the practice run is a safe walk-through of teaching, importing and confirming on sample documents — nothing there touches your real files.
steps.caption: Try a practice run — safe sample documents

steps.narration: And the full User Guide is always a click away.
steps.caption: The User Guide is always here

steps.narration: So that's the whole idea: bring your documents in, give the odd one a quick check, and then find any of them forever. The next videos walk through each step, starting with your first import.
steps.caption: Bring in · check · find forever
